record.destination: Wayfinder-style planning works at three altitudes with granularity to match: (1) roadmap shaping — 5k ft, create/edit/move roadmap nodes like a mind map without going deep; (2) ideation — 10k ft, 'wouldn't it be cool if' PO/CEO-level brainstorm of new features; (3) feature definition — PRD-level, how a feature works and its sub-features. Each altitude gets the partner posture: grills the human for decisions only they can make, runs research/prototype tickets AFK and returns with findings, makes delegated judgment calls, and hands off to build the moment the human says 'enough to start' — no full de-fogging required.

payload.body: Phase 4 already shipped the substrate: maps, 4 ticket types (research/prototype/grilling/task), advisory blocking, frontier, derived decisions, chart-map.md + work-map.md workflows. This feature builds the CONDUCTOR on top. Matt Pocock's wayfinder + grill-with-docs (github.com/mattpocock/skills, skills/engineering/) are the reference; grill-with-docs is one line delegating to grilling + domain-modeling. Vendoring decision: pin via existing skills.yaml/lock machinery (F7/ADR-0009) — needs a locateSkill fix for the skills/engineering/ subdir. Ideation altitude may ship later than the other two, but the flow design accounts for all three. Grilling tickets are always HITL — the partner never answers its own interview questions.
